Task: Extract NDVI and terrain features from MODIS
Compute NDVI from MODIS MOD09GA surface reflectance bands, combines it with state_1km QA data and SRTM-derived elevation, slope, and aspect at 500m resolution, then samples this multiband time-series stack over a land cover mask (class 321) to export point data for analysis. Output is a vector collection of sampled pixels with NDVI, terrain, and QA attributes.

Task: Map growing season onset variability
Analyze the interannual variability of agricultural growing season onset dates (short and main seasons) by computing standard deviation and percentiles from a time series of EVI-derived onset day-of-year images between 2003 and 2018, masked to agricultural land cover. Outputs include median, 10th/90th percentiles, and standard deviation maps of onset timing, which are exported to Earth Engine Assets and Google Drive for visualization with a custom legend.

planner_view.task:
Task: Classify agricultural land cover
Classify land cover types in a specific PAS zone using Landsat 8 surface reflectance data from May to December 2021. It computes spectral indices (NDVI, NDWI, NBR), generates seasonal composites and per-pixel statistics (median, max, min, stdDev), and applies a Random Forest classifier trained on field-collected ground truth data. The classification is post-processed with focal mode filtering, water masking from JRC Global Surface Water, and integration with MapBiomas Pampa land cover data for refinement. Outputs include a classified raster map, confusion matrix, accuracy metrics (overall, user’s, producer’s), and area calculation per class in hectares.

Task: Model vegetation seasonality trend
the workflow models long-term vegetation dynamics in Laikipia Area using harmonic regression on Landsat-derived VI (NDVI) time series from 1982 to 2019, estimating seasonal patterns, linear trends, and goodness-of-fit (R-squared). Outputs include a linear trend map, fitted harmonic model chart at a point, and spatial layers of trend slope, R-squared, and seasonality (phase, magnitude, mean VI).

planner_view.task:
Task: Extract NDVI time series for farm locations
Analyze wheat and rice cultivation areas in Uttar Pradesh using the GFSAD1000 land cover dataset. It extracts 100 stratified sample points from cropland (class 1) within the administrative boundary of Uttar Pradesh, then processes Sentinel-2A/B SR (Surface Reflectance) imagery from 2019 to compute NDVI. Cloud and shadow masking is applied using SCL and probability bands. For each point, a full-year NDVI time series is generated, and maximum annual NDVI values are computed per location. The final output includes three charts: a single-point NDVI time series, column chart of max NDVI across all points, and regional time series by all points, with a CSV export of the complete NDVI time series per point for external use.
